items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I think Taft, Jordon and Edgar Sampson -- couple of (inaudible), you know, just the top men in the band (inaudible) running the band (inaudible).

ctx.x: Middle West, and things like that. Those dates were still pending.

And they decided to -- we put Bill Beeson on drums and (inaudible) the band up. I wasn't running the band that time. I think Taft, Jordon and Edgar Sampson -- couple of (inaudible), you know, just the top men in the band (inaudible) running the band (inaudible).
It was their decision to put Beeson in on drums?
